symptom: A Local turn longer than the engine's 1000-row snap budget reopened with no user prompt: the 200-row tail window started inside the turn and rendered headless.
rule: A window that cannot be snapped carries its turn's opening prompt beside the contiguous rows, and every front trim, prepend and replacement re-derives it (docs/ui-interaction-performance.md, playbooks/bug-fix.md).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/workspace/__tests__/service.test.ts -t 'opening prompt on Local tail windows'
